purpose: Teach: カバン/五つ/浴びる/ジャガイモ/年下/指先/注意深く/かすか

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんのカバンに、お土産、入ってるよ、見てごらん、何かな?
lines.en: Sho — there's a souvenir in Mei-sis's bag. Go on, take a look. What do you think it is?
lines.style: Playful invitation. Gentle, teasing lilt on the opening address. Warm smile in the voice. Patient pause, giving him space to be curious without rushing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、メダル、五つも、運動会で、もらったんだよ、メイ姉さん、すごいでしょ?
lines.en: Mei-sis, I got five medals at sports day. I did, I really did. Pretty amazing, right?
lines.style: Bright, eager rush of pride. Quick tempo. Small voice bouncing with accomplishment. Seeks approval — genuine eagerness, not performance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 夏は、毎日、水浴び、浴びるのが、楽しい季節ね、翔くん、海、行こうね。
lines.en: Summer's the best season — every day we can swim and cool off. We should go to the sea together, shouldn't we, Sho?
lines.style: Warm invitation. Light, summery pacing. Gentle enthusiasm — painting a picture rather than proposing. The 'we' carries invitation, not demand.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さんの作るジャガイモ料理、ぼく、大好きなんだよ、また、作ってね、お願い。
lines.en: I love the potato dishes you make, Mei-sis. Could you make them again? Please?
lines.style: Soft, earnest request. Small voice, genuine affection underneath. The 'please' carries real longing — not manipulation, just honest need for something she makes.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、翔くんより、年下の従妹、いるのよ、知ってた?今度、紹介するね。
lines.en: You know, Mei-sis has a younger cousin who's close to your age, Sho. I want to introduce you sometime.
lines.style: Gentle, tender. Thoughtful pacing — she's offering something she's considered. Slight warmth on 'introduce' — this matters to her. No pressure underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 指先で、お絵描き、もっと、上手になりたいよ、メイ姉さん、教えてくれる?
lines.en: I want to get better at drawing with my fingertips. Will you teach me, Mei-sis?
lines.style: Earnest, quiet determination. Small but steady voice. The question rises gently — hopeful but not demanding. Genuine interest driving the ask.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 公園で、注意深く、転ばないように、走ろうね、翔くん、約束ね。
lines.en: At the park, we need to be careful and watch our step so we don't fall, all right? Promise me you'll run safely, Sho.
lines.style: Gentle but firm. Steady, protective tone — not anxious, just present. Slight weight on 'promise' — this matters. Tender underneath the instruction.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、夜、かすかに、星、見えるよ、空、すごく綺麗、見て、ね、本当に!
lines.en: Mei-sis, look — at night, you can see the stars so faintly. The sky is so beautiful. Look, really, it's true!
lines.style: Small voice filled with awe. Urgent, wondering tone — he needs her to see what he sees. Quick breath between thoughts. Gentle insistence on the beauty.
